name: access-review
description: Review who can do what in an enterprise system: segregation of duties conflicts, leavers who keep access, unknown accounts, privileged users, unused and redundant roles. Reads exported files, fetches nothing, no dependencies.

scripts.example: node bin/access-review.js --roles examples/roles.json --assignments examples/assignments.csv --people examples/people.csv --rules examples/rules.json

author: INNERLUXES <info@innerluxes.dev>
